NFL Simulation
Simulates each game outside-in: the consensus total and spread set the game's score, that score sets each team's yardage and pass/run script, and every player's prop line rides those team factors. Stack and bring-back correlation come out of that structure — a QB and his WR share the same team draw. Needs Team + Position; O/U, Spread and TmTot (from the odds puller) make the game environments real.
Simulations
2000
Stacking
Correlation is already in the sim — these rules force it into the lineups you actually submit. "QB + N" requires N pass catchers (WR/TE) from the QB's own team; "bring-back" requires a skill player from the opposing team, the play that wins shootouts.
QB + Bring-back
PGA Simulation
Simulates full tournaments: finishes calibrated to the de-vigged odds ladder, AM/PM wave correlation, the cut after R2, and DK hole-by-hole scoring shaped per golfer and anchored to the course scoring environment (Par + Field vs par). Requires odds mapped. Contest EV Mode on = lineups priced vs your contest's payout curve and a modeled field (needs Own%); off = Sim Score mode, lineups ranked by their joint score on held-out sims.
Simulations
2000
Make cut (top N) Par Field vs par
Skill Correlation
Each simulated tournament draws "how the course played" — sims where an axis swings lift every golfer strong in that skill together, so correlated skill-set lineups emerge naturally. Higher = that skill separates the field harder here.
Tee Wave
Each sim draws AM/PM session shocks (R1, flipped in R2, feeding the cut). Volatility = how much the draw matters this week — crank it for links/weather weeks, cut it for calm small-field events. Lean = a known forecast edge: shifts the average two-round draw toward one wave while keeping the randomness.

Payout structure
Field modeled from Own% under cap/no-oppose, dup-adjusted, with a standard ±35% allowance for ownership projection error. Risk is standardized to the slate stake (assumes entries follow your bankroll management). Leverage stances are AUTO-solved per slate: worlds are weighted by orphaned equity (dead ownership × how rosterable the beneficiary was), and the strength is chosen by a logged sweep — most top-0.5% coverage within a bounded EV give-up. Slider 0 = auto (default); above 0 pins the strength manually.
Requires ML mapped. Sim samples fight outcomes from odds, picks optimal lineup per sim, ranks by frequency.
